notes.title: Version 1.1 Released : Achievements & small fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41342505/b9410fed7301fc3e102831e43e7ff02da2be138d.jpg[/img]

Patch notes:

NEW:
-	Achievements: we’ve added a bunch of achievements.
-	Steam cloud save: your gamesave is now synced using Steam.

FIX:
-	Dialogs and texts : fixed a few typos
-	Other minor fixes 

BREAK:
This update will break your gamesave for the level you are playing. If you have an ongoing level, you will have to restart it. We are sorry for the inconvenience; it is an overhaul and should now be future proof!
